strings.en: I won't let you do as you please!
I get it... how to move this thing...!
Hurry, hurry up and move! Moooove!
Go, move!
If I don't do it, I'll be killed!
L-Like hell I'll let you beat me!
Granteed, lend me your strength!
Go, Granteed! Please, go!
Even I... even I can handle this much!
I'll do it... Let's go, Granteed!
With this thing, I should be able to do it!
With the Granteed's power!
That's what you get for showing up there!
We should be able to do it too!
Stay calm and watch the enemy's movements.../　just like Dad did.
If it's kill or be killed... then I'll do it!
I don't know what secrets/　the Granteed holds, but.../　I'll fight too, Dad...!
If you're going to stand in our way!
Too slow! Moving like that!
With this thing, no matter who I'm up against!
We can do it!
Dad, we'll show you we can do it...!
Out of my way!
Don't get in my waaay!!
Uuuuaaah!!
Disappeeeear!!
T-Touya...!
Katia, Busker Mode.
...! I-I know, it's this, right?!
I can do this... Right, Dad?!
I'll do it...!
Here I goooo!!
Deeyah!
Ooooraaah!!
Haaah!
Haaaaah!!
I can still go!
Take this!
How's thaaaaaat!!
In Dad's place, I'll finish you off!
Go, Basileus!
Dracodeus docking sequence!
Complete!
Draco! Knuckle!!
Finger Crusher!!
Katia, Busker Mode!
Right, activating!
Draco Slave! Take thiiis!!
Tou-Ya, now is the time to end this battle.
Right!
Orgone Materialization!
Gu-Landon! Prepare yourself!
Ooooooooh!!
Into the darkness of Voda! Siiiiink!!
Gu-Landon.../　your war... is over.
Docking!
Haaaah!
Tenia, Busker Mode!
OK, activating!
Draco Slaaaave!!
Next! Take this!
Draco Blasteeeer!!
Sink into the darkness of Voda, Gu-Landon!
Taaaaaaah!!
Prepare yourself!!
It's back!
Raise the output, the Lancer!
Yes! Limiter, cut!
Basileus, I'm counting on you!
Hyaah!
Uooooooh!!
Melua! Orgone Cloud, full deployment!
Yes, deploying!
Haaaaaaah!!
Into the darkness of Voda!
Siiink!!
Touya... It's okay. You can do it.
How should I know?! But I've got no choice, right?!
The enemy! C-Can I do this?!
It's okay. Focus, Touya.
Damn it! I-I can do it too!
Touya, don't rush.
We can go now. Touya, hurry!
Got it!/　Damn it, I won't let you do as you please!
The enemy's slow to evade. Touya, now!
G-Got it!
Hah, hah, hah...!
Touya, calm down. Switch to attacking!
All right, let's go!
Good, Touya!
Can I keep this up...?!
It's okay, we can do it!
Extractor output stable... Touya!
Yeah, let's go!
We're catching that guy, Katia!
Cytron control normal. We can go!
Can I do it...? No, I'll do it!
Touya, leave the backup to me!
Can we counter like this?
Yes, we can!
The enemy's running?! After it, Granteed!
Touya, keep an eye on your surroundings too!
Touya, don't miss the timing!
I know that!
Touya, now! We can do it!
Yeah, I know!
I can tell, the Granteed Dracodeus/　is telling me to go!
Touya...!
Whatever we're up against, we can do it!
Yes, we can. Let's go, Touya!
That guy's slow... We're catching him, Katia!
Yes, all right!
What the Cytron shows us.../　I just have to feel it. Let's go, Katia!
Y-Yes, anytime!
Katia, we're counterattacking!
Right, got it!
Surroundings clear, we can go!
Got it!
Before they get away!
Let's go, you two!
There's no need to worry about me.
Anytime, Touya!
Touya, here it comes!
Yeah, I see it! Shana-Mia, ready?
I leave it to you.
I'm attacking now. Ready, Shana-Mia?
Yes, I leave it to you.
This might get a little rough./　Bear with me, Shana-Mia.
I too am the Princess of the Fury. I'll be fine./　Please, go.
Tou-Ya.../　Allow me to see how you fight.
Your back... It resembles E-Selda's.
Huh? R-Really...?
I can't back down here!
Tou-Ya...
A Zovorg commander unit...!
It moves differently? Can I catch it...?
Even if it's a little strong, the Granteed can!
That's a Zovorg commander unit! Be careful!
I know!/　You make sure to back me up, too!
I won't let the Golaikunru do as they please!
Whatever Zovorg weapon you are,/　don't think you can stop us!
Commander unit or not,/　I'll push you back with this thing's power!
War merchants, stop meddling with our planet!
Like hell I'll let the war merchants have their way!
Touya, Golaikunru's commander unit is coming!
We'll stop it, ourselves!
Not to some war merchants...!
I won't let Golaikunru do as they please!
That machine looks really powerful, but...!
That woman's throwing the battlefield into chaos...!
What the hell is with that woman?!
That machine is among the Zovorg's strongest!/　Be careful!
You're strong... But we can't/　let ourselves be beaten so easily!
Al-Van!/　About Dad, about the Granteed.../　I'll get it all out of you!
Answer me, Al-Van!/　What are you saying Dad and I even are?!
Al-Van... That man killed our parents...!
Katia, focus! Let's go!
Calvina isn't your opponent!/　We and the Granteed are!
Reggiane, I won't let you stall for time!
That Gyanonia is faster than the Ogre!
We can catch it with this thing's system!
Lamaris... It supposedly means negative thoughts...
Monster.../　I'll blow you away with the Granteed!
Touya, the Lamaris are coming!
I know! Those things, with the Granteed!
Like I'd let the Lamaris/　do whatever they want!
Lamaris... I'll wipe you out, as many times as it takes!
Lamaris Kaana.../　So what if you got bigger!
Even against a monster like that... I have to do it?
Damn it, you monster! I'll do it too!
Even against a Lamaris Kaana,/　the Granteed can do it!
Lamaris Kaana detected. Touya!
Roger! Let's go, Granteed!
Lamaris Kaana.../　With the Granteed's current energy,/　I should be able to wipe it out!
XN-L... You bring ruin, and I'll be the one/　to strike you down, as E-Selda's son! Prepare yourself!
XN-L!/　Fureim rejects your very existence!
And so do we, of course!
Where's the enemy?! There!
Touya, you're rushing it!
Let's go, Tenia. Back me up!
OK, Touya!
You good, Tenia?!
Leave this side to me! You focus on control, Touya!
Enemy! We can push right through, Touya!
The Granteed can do it! We'll be fine!
I don't need you to tell me that!
I won't let the enemy get away!
Touya, don't rush it!
We can do this too! Ready, Tenia?
OK! Leave the backup to me!
Touya, now!
Yeah, you're not getting away!
Tenia, let's go!
Ready when you are!
I'll master this thing's power!
Yeah, we'll be fine together!
Let's go, Tenia. With this thing's power...!
Yeah, we can take on anyone!
Touya, the rest is up to you!
Honestly, you... All right, let's go!
Touya, leave the backup to me!
Yeah, I'm counting on you!
Tenia, lock on to that one too!
OK!
Touya, we can counter now!
All right, let's do this!
Touya, don't miss your timing!
I know! You're not getting away!
Tenia, Shana-Mia, let's go!
Yes, I leave it to you.
Ready whenever you are!
Touya, they're in our range!
Roger! Let's go, Shana-Mia!
Yes, go ahead.
Touya, that one's strong! Be careful!
I know that without being told!
Touya, it's the Golaikunru commander's unit!
Roger! Back me up!
That's the Baran-Schneil! It's strong!
We'll stop it, together!
He's the one who killed Dad and Mom and the others.../　I'll never forgive him!
Al-Van is strong!/　Stay calm and back me up, Tenia!
Another type of Gyanonia! But together we can do it!
Yeah, let's do this! Come on, Reggiane!
Touya, Lamaris incoming! Get 'em!
Yeah, I'll hit it!
No matter how big it gets, we can take it!
Yeah, let's do this!
Touya, just sealing XN-L away isn't enough!
Right, I'll erase its existence... and then!
Melua, you ready?
Yes, I'm fine. With us and this machine...
Touya, the Granteed will be fine.
Yeah, I'll give it everything I've got!
We're going in! Ready, Melua?
Yes, leave the backup to me!
Melua, we're attacking!
Yes!
Where's the enemy... Where is it?!
Touya, don't be hasty.
Before I lose sight of them!
Touya, there's no need to rush!
All right, this timing should work!
Yes, we can do it!
Now! Counterattack!
With this thing and us...!
We can take on anyone, no problem!
Granteed Dracodeus.../　I'll master you!
Yes! Let's go, Touya!
There... That's my target. Let's go, Melua!
Yes, Touya!
Touya, go ahead anytime!
I'll control it,/　even this Granteed Dracodeus!
I'll help too!
We can counter, Touya!
Yeah, now it's our turn!
With this timing...!
We can counterattack!
They're still locked on to us!
All right, counterattacking!
Melua, you ready? Shana-Mia?
Yes, anytime!
I'm all right as well.
Touya, now!
Right! Shana-Mia!
A high-end Zovorg unit, huh. Melua!
Y-Yes! Bringing up the Cytron's movement prediction!
Touya, that's a high-end Golaikunru unit!/　Please be careful!
Okay, got it!
The Baran-Schneil... Melua, can we do this?!
Yes, with this machine and us!
The person in that machine is the one who killed/　Dad and Mom...
I know... and that's exactly why/　I can't let him beat me!
With the Cytron,/　we should be able to catch even that new model!
Yes! The movement prediction's coming in!
Touya, I don't want to see that thing up close...
I get it, but we have to do this!
Touya, I can target that big one!
Got it! We're attacking!
The will of Fureim.../　I feel as though I understand it too.
For this final battle... I'm counting on you too, Melua!
Damn skeleton... The Granteed will be your opponent!
Here I come, Skull Knight!
The Skull Knight... The Granteed/　should be able to fight even something like that!
I'll carve a path with the Granteed!
With this Granteed Dracodeus...!
Don't underestimate/　the power of the Granteed Dracodeus!
What Dad entrusted to me.../　I think I understand it now. So/　I'll do it. With this Granteed!
We have to end this fight/　with the Granteed Dracodeus...!
It will be all right. You have me with you, after all.
Skull Knight!/　I won't let your plans succeed!
I won't let some guy like Dark Brain come back!
We've got a dragon too!/　Bring it on, Crystal Dragoon!
With the Coustwell Brachium...!
Let's go, Coustwell Brachium!
Together,/　we can master even the Coustwell!
Even in the Coustwell, I'll pull it off!
I have to draw his attention somehow...!
What the hell is that guy?! Take thiiis!
You're not getting the Granteed! Never!
Damn it, what the hell are you?!/　What about Dad and this machine?!
Dad is dead! You people killed him!
What did you just do back there?!
I won't let you pull that trick!
I'm not getting caught again and again!
Because of you, Dad...!/　I'll never let you have the Granteed!
Where's that gray unit?!
I won't let you do as you please!
I'll never hand over the Granteed/　Dad left behind to the likes of you!
With this Granteed.../　Here I come, Jua-Mu!
Jua-Mu, I won't let things go your way!
We'll stop you ourselves!
I'll protect the Granteed, Jua-Mu!
He's in a Raftclans...? Even so!
If Al-Van won't show himself,/　I'll just get it out of you!
Jua-Mu! Are you going to ignore her wishes/　and fight too?!
Jua-Mu, you...!/　Don't you understand what Shana-Mia wants?!
We can't back down either!/　Here we come, Jua-Mu!
Jua-Mu, if you insist on fighting,/　we won't hold back either!
Return to the darkness of Voda, Jua-Mu Dalubi!
Tou-Ya... Please stop him./　No more of this...
Got it. If that's the only way...!
One way or another, you're letting us through!
We're your opponents! Here we come, Fu-Ruu!
Why would someone like you/　ignore Shana-Mia's wishes and fight?!
Fu-Ruu! If you turn your blade/　on Shana-Mia, you're no knight anymore!
Stop this! Stop it, Fu-Ruu!
It's no use, Shana-Mia./　Fighting is the only way to stop her!
Karo-Ran! You! You killed Dad!!
Karo-Ran! I can't forgive you!
Larseilam won't work anymore!
Karo-Ran... In place of my father, E-Selda,/　I, Tou-Ya Shune, will strike you down!
It's you... You're the root of all this!
Gu-Landon Gortz!/　Tou-Ya, son of E-Selda, will face you!/　Here I come!
Gu-Landon Gortz!/　I'll send you back to the darkness of Voda!
Knight Commander Gu-Landon.../　You're the root of it all, and I,/　E-Selda's son, will defeat you! Prepare yourself!
Let us defeat him, Tou-Ya.
Yeah... I'll hit him with everything/　the Granteed Dracodeus has!
It is over, Gu-Landon!
I'll stop the Zee-Gadin!
Get out of our waaay!
Right now, getting out of here comes first!
Granteed Dracodeus.../　We'll master it together, Dad!
It's because weirdos like you/　keep showing up!
I won't let a clown like that do as he pleases!
Here I come, Debudedabide!
Debudedabide! Vanish with the ghosts of the past!
It's because of war profiteers like you!
A Gadisword commander's unit!
What are you plotting with the Golaikunru?!
Like I'd lose to you!
He's in a Gyanonia too...!
I can't let you catch me!
Bilgo! I don't have time for you!
Bilgo! Out of the way!
I won't let you hurt Akimi and the others!
No data... A new Gadisword model?!
We have to stop Herluga!/　You should understand why, too!
We're getting through to the Rabulpaila!
The Cross Gate isn't something you can handle!
I'll seal you and the Cross Gate both/　with this Granteed Dracodeus!
Stop! Without the key,/　touching the Gate of Voda is dangerous!
That's exactly why we have to stop him,/　right?!
Is that the Golaikunru's boss...?!
What the hell are those things...?!
And we need to get/　to the Cross Gate...!
The Granteed.../　Fureim is lending us its power!
Is this going to be a fated battle/　between Hakam...?!
That thing and the Granteed.../　To think Fureim was the same kind of being...!
Do not be misled./　There is only one thing we must do here and now.
An alien machine...!
I won't let the Zovorg have their way!
Coming from another planet just to wage war...!
Not to some Zovorg robot!
The Zovorg, huh... I can do this too!
Even against aliens, this Granteed can do it!
You people spread the fighting! Get lost!
Golaikunru or not,/　the Granteed Dracodeus can handle it!
I won't let you get to the Gadisword units!
We've got to draw them in ourselves...!
If you want a target, aim at this Granteed!
I'm supposed to fight something like that...?!
I can't take concentrated fire...!
It's a big target, so it's easy to hit, but...!
It's slow... Then I should be able to do this!
A Zeranio-class!
With this thing, I can go toe-to-toe with a battleship!
What the hell are those things...!
Whatever they are, if they're coming at us...!
They're after the Granteed? Then...!
Those guys...! If they're the enemy...!
Damn the Fury... I won't let them!
If you're coming after the Granteed...!
Fury.../　Don't think things will go as you planned!
Fury or whatever,/　if I have to fight, then I will!
You're coming at me,/　at this Granteed Dracodeus?!
If you don't want to die, back off!
You think you can take this thing on in a Donna Lumpy?!
Don't think a Ganjar can stop this thing!
Even if it's a Volrent!
Don't get confused about who you should be fighting!
Without even knowing how Shana-Mia feels...!
We have to end this fight, and fast!
I can't let my guard down with a Thorn... Careful now!
That enemy's dangerous...! But I have to do this!
A Thorn, huh... If that's their commander's unit...!
Is it some kind of... ghost?
They can combine...?!
They combined and got bigger...?!
We have to purify the Ida quickly...!
Ares Geist...?/　What am I supposed to do against that?!
That thing... Is it connected to the Lamaris somehow?
I'm not the one you should be fighting!
I won't let you become Dark Brain's vessel!
It can't be that different from Earth's mobile weapons!
Don't think being a little fast/　means you can escape the Granteed!
A Gadisword machine!
We have no choice but to retreat for now...!
I won't let you near the Hagane and Hiryu Custom!
So this is a fight we can't avoid...!
Our target is Herluga!/　Don't get in our way!
Gadisword's royal guard!
Royal guard or not!
I'll hit you back!
That enemy! N-Now it's our turn!
I-I can target it. Then I'll...!
You won't get away that easily!
We can do it too...!
With this timing, I can counter!
I'm not ending it like this!
Don't miss the chance to counter... Right, Dad?
If you're coming after the Granteed...!
I won't let you have/　the Granteed Dad left me!
I'll hit you back, too!
Like I'd let you pull out that easily!
I won't miss a chance to counter!
Trying to pull out, huh?!
Like I'd miss a chance to strike!
With this thing's power, I can catch up!
Just like Dad taught me, I won't miss my chance!
Now I'm making my move!
Now it's my turn!
N-Not here!!
No way, the Granteed...!
I-I can't take any more... Dad...
No, the Granteed!!
I won't go down until I know the truth!
Waaaaah!!
N-Not here, not without knowing anything.../　Move! Move, Granteed!!
Wh-Whoaaah!!
How do I recover?! How?!
I-I have to do this as well as Dad would...!
I-I wasn't overconfident about/　the Granteed's toughness, but...!
Calm down, calm down...!/　I'm not beaten yet!
Hang in there, Granteed!!
It's not absorbing all the impact!
Wh-What the hell?! Every readout's bright red!
A direct hit...!/　Am I not handling the Cytron right?!
Damn iiit! Like hell I'll let you!!
Not yet! Not yeeet!!
Kyaaaah!!
D-Dad...!/　Granteed! Do something!
A d-direct hit?! Touya?!
Ugh... Dad... Dad...
Touya, pull yourself together!
The upper body's wobbling! The balancer?!
Yes, it can't fully compensate/　for the damage to the lumbar section!
Ngh! The output's dropping!
I'll lower the average and stabilize it!
Kyaaah!!
Katia?!/　Ngh, I can't let it end like this!
Urgh! A direct hit!!
DCS, red alert!/　It's dangerous to keep going, Touya!
Touya, we took a direct hit!
I know!/　Are you all right? What about Shana-Mia?
I am unharmed.
...S-Sorry, Shana-Mia./　If worst comes to worst, at least you...
Tou-Ya, just as I did your father,/　I have placed my trust in you as a knight./　I do not wish to hear such weakness.
A-Al-Van! That guy!!
Touya! With your blood boiling like that,/　you can't beat him!
Ngh... I-If I keep fighting Al-Van,/　he'll beat me...?!
Ugh.../　Getting taken out by Lamaris would be the worst...!
Ngh! We have to beat the Lamaris fast!
Urgh! Damn Lamaris, darting all over!
If we keep taking hits like this, we're in trouble!
Th-The controls! What's happening?!
The main processor's malfunctioning!/　Switching to the sub!
H-Hey! If this seat's shaking/　this much, it's really bad!!
I know that much, all right?!
Touya, don't be reckless!/　We won't last much longer like this!
Then do something with the DCS!
T-Touya! At this rate...!
It's fine, trust me!
Ngh, the thrusters aren't firing right...?!/　Check what's wrong!
OK! Shana-Mia, can you look too?
Y-Yes.
I-If he catches me,/　I don't know what'll happen to me!
I've got no intention of getting caught!
T-Touya, what are you doing?!
That Lamaris is so fast!
Ngh! Melua, what's our status?!
D-Damage control alert!/　If we take any more,/　we won't be able to move properly!
Damn it, the extractor won't stabilize!
I'll manage it with a 5% output drop!
Kyaaah!!
A-Are you all right, Melua?!
Urgh, the controls.../　Melua, how's it on your end...?!
Not good, Touya. Alerts everywhere./　We can't take any more hits!
Damn it, we took a beating...!
It will be all right. Let us trust/　in the Throne Unit... and in ourselves.
That's right, Touya!
T-Touya! I don't want to lose to that person!
Neither do I!
I-I don't wanna get beaten by that thing!
I don't plan to either!
S-So you know the Granteed/　pretty well, huh...?!
Like hell I'll give in to the Fury now!
It held out... Impressive...!
So they won't go easy just because it's a Throne Unit./　I knew that, but...!
I won't let a woman like that/　take down the Granteed!
Not yet, it's not over yet!/　Hold on, Coustwell!
Not yet! The Coustwell can still fight!
Ngh... I-I don't want this, Dad.../　Not to some monster like that...!
I-I'm not dying here!/　Not until I know the truth!!
Not yet, hold on a little longer, Granteed...!/　Dad entrusted you to me,/　and I won't let that guy take you!
Damn you, So-Des!/　I won't go down that easily!
Ngh!/　To think Jua-Mu could do this much to me!
Ngh... Th-That guy!/　He's gotten stronger in that Raftclans!
A direct hit?!/　He's moving differently than before!
No good, I can't fully dodge it!/　Can't I read that new model's moves?!
Ugh, I'm cornered?!/　Damn it, Jua-Mu! You...!!
You'll pay for that, Jua-Mu!!
So this is his rage...!
Urgh! I told you the Princess is aboard!
Ngh, he's strong... As strong as Al-Van...?!
Fu-Ruu! Why do you go this far?!
Not to you!/　Like hell I'll lose to the likes of you!!
Did he get me?! Damn you, Karo-Ran!
Not yet, Karo-Ran! I swear I'll/　sink you into the darkness of Voda!
Gu-Landon!/　We're not beaten yet!
G-Gu-Landon... I won't give in to you!/　Never!
Y-You have neither the right/　nor the qualifications to rule the Fury!
I-I have to stop them in their tracks somehow!
Ugh, Gadisword's new model... It's strong!
His Gyanonia is acting as a wall...!
The Gate of Voda will bring great disaster!/　You know that yourself, don't you?!
Damn it, no more from some war profiteer!
I won't flinch!/　I can't let them reach the colony!
I won't let that ridiculous woman go any further!
I-I'm not down yet, Debudedabide!!
Damn it!/　I have to figure out the Skull Knight's moves!
I-If we don't stop XN-L here,/　planets other than Earth will...!
Aren't you, like Gu-Landon,/　fighting the wrong enemy?!
Urgh! So what if they're aliens?!
It's not like the mass-produced ones...!
I-If I go down like this, it'll all be for nothing!
Th-This is bad, I need to get away from that ship!
I won't go down without knowing anything!
Wha?! That White Horn is strong!
Ngh, ugh...!/　Am I no match for the Thorn...?!
I can't handle it?! That new model... It's strong!
Ngh, it's tough! That Lamaris Kaana!
Y-You monster... What power...!
Ngh, I can't keep them drawn in for long!
Urgh!/　If I take too long, there'll be no undoing it!
Urgh, right in a bad spot!
The legs aren't damaged! I can still move!
I came out here ready for this!
Ugh!/　No way, I took that head-on...?!
I-I'm hit?!/　I have to do something, something...!
Ugh, I need to move faster than this...!
The Granteed can still take it!
Ngh! I knew they were aiming at me, too!
Damn it, was that my mistake?!
Ngh, if only the Orgone Extractor/　were intact...!
With this thing's power and durability...!
Kyaah!!
Katia?! Damn it, at this rate...!
We can manage for now, but if this keeps up...!
Damn it, like hell I'll go down!
What, did we get hit?!
We can still fight! Hang in there!
Damn! Katia, how bad's the damage?!
It's still within the DCS's tolerance!
Touya, move more nimbly!
Easy for you to say, with a machine this size!
Ngh! Where did it hit us?!
I'll put the damaged areas on your monitor!
We're hit! Katia, how is it?!
It's fine, still within the DCS's tolerance./　We can keep going.
Touya, we've taken damage! DCS active!/　Handling's not affected, but be careful!
Right! But I won't let them do any more!
Ngh, Al-Van...! I...!
Al-Van... You're strong, but/　the Granteed can still fight too!
A-Al-Van... He's strong...!
Ngh, there has to be an opening! There has to!
Hold on, Granteed! I can't let/　Al-Van beat me here!
Ngh, to think the Lamaris could do this much to us...
Dammit, I won't let the Lamaris do any more!
Touya, it's small, so watch its movements closely!
R-Right!
Damn it, the Granteed won't fall to this!
That's right, we can still fight!
Hey, Touya! Pilot properly!
